prompt: Many people believe that cooking is an essential life skill and should be taught to both boys and girls in schools. Others disagree and believe that it is a waste of school time. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
essay:
People have different opinions regarding what should be included in the school curriculum. Some support the addition of cooking classes , while others believe it is unnecessary. I believe that cooking can be added in curriculum , but more importance should be given to core subjects.

One major reason why schools should offer cooking classes is to add variety to students' daily learning experience. Many schools have started to teach lessons on different ingredients, receipes and the usage of various kitchen utensils. These classes allow students to learn the importance of food and exposure to diverse cuisines, also offering them an opportunity to learn something different from their regular curriculum. When children explore unique techniques and experiments in their school environment, they can improve their overall performance effectively.

Others who disagree about cooking lessons place more emphasis on general academic subjects. Since most high-wage jobs are available in science, maths and business classes, they can greatly contribute to students' careers in their future. Cooking classes may distract students from their career paths and take valuable time from academic studies. Children can learn basic cooking in their homes with their parents.  Therefore, schools should focus more on core subjects that are directly related to employment opportunities.

In my opinion, schools should adopt a balanced approach. This is because children become bored when they learn similar topics repeatedly. If different subjects are included in the academic syllabus, students can maintain their interest in the main subjects while learning different skills. This strategy will help children enjoy learning and develop new abilities.

In conclusion, educating students about diverse skills can make them capable of dealing with various challenges in daily life. Although some believe that cooking is necessary to make children independent, the importance of other subjects is also vital. Therefore, I believe that students should be provided with the opportunity to develop both academic knowledge and practical skills.
